lines.en: Welcome to the bookshop! Are you looking for anything special, or just enjoying the books displayed in the window?
lines.pt: Bem-vinda à livraria! Procura algo especial ou está só curtindo os livros expostos na vitrine?

lines.en: Actually, yes. The book written by my uncle won a prize last year, and I wanted to buy a signed copy.
lines.pt: Na verdade, sim. O livro escrito pelo meu tio ganhou um prêmio ano passado, e queria comprar um exemplar autografado.

lines.en: What a coincidence! We sell several novels from small publishers here in Chicago. What is the title?
lines.pt: Que coincidência! Vendemos vários romances de pequenas editoras aqui em Chicago. Qual é o título?

lines.en: It is called The Last Harbor. He spent ten years writing it, and many people thought he would never finish.
lines.pt: Chama-se The Last Harbor. Ele levou dez anos escrevendo, e muita gente achou que nunca terminaria.

lines.en: I remember it! The stories told in that book felt so real. Is the copy you need for a gift?
lines.pt: Lembro dele! As histórias contadas naquele livro pareciam tão reais. O exemplar é para presente?

lines.en: Yes, for my mother. She is tired of cheap paperbacks, and she loves any story about the sea.
lines.pt: Sim, para minha mãe. Ela está cansada de brochuras baratas e adora qualquer história sobre o mar.

lines.en: Then you are lucky. The boxes delivered this morning include a special edition with a page signed by the author.
lines.pt: Então você tem sorte. As caixas entregues hoje de manhã incluem uma edição especial com uma página assinada pelo autor.

lines.en: Perfect! How much is it? I only have a small budget, because the tickets booked for December were expensive.
lines.pt: Perfeito! Quanto custa? Tenho um orçamento pequeno, porque as passagens reservadas para dezembro saíram caras.

lines.en: It is thirty dollars. If you prefer, I can also wrap it, since gifts bought here usually get a ribbon for free.
lines.pt: São trinta dólares. Se preferir, posso embrulhar, já que presentes comprados aqui costumam ganhar uma fita de graça.

lines.en: That would be lovely. I have been looking for a gift for weeks, and I am relieved to have found one.
lines.pt: Seria ótimo. Procuro um presente há semanas, e fico aliviada por ter achado um.

lines.en: Wonderful. Please tell your uncle he is welcome to join our reading evening next Friday, if he is free.
lines.pt: Maravilha. Diga ao seu tio que ele é bem-vindo à nossa noite de leitura na próxima sexta, se estiver livre.

facts.big: the book written by · the boxes delivered
facts.label: Relativa reduzida com particípio
facts.sub: Use o particípio passado depois do substantivo: The book written by my uncle won a prize. The boxes delivered this morning are here.

facts.label: Reduzir com particípio
facts.sub: Tire which was ou that were e use o particípio: the book that was written by my uncle vira the book written by my uncle. O sentido é passivo.

facts.label: Coisas e objetos
facts.sub: Use para objetos e textos: the boxes delivered this morning, gifts bought here, the stories told in that book, the tickets booked for December. Soa natural e curto.

compare.ask: The book written by my uncle won a prize.
compare.br: No Brasil, dizemos “o livro escrito por meu tio”, em vez de “o livro que foi escrito”.
compare.tip: Diga: “The book written by my uncle won a prize.”
compare.us: Em inglês: the book which was written → the book written. Tira-se which was e usa-se o particípio.

solo: Peça uma experiência pessoal do aluno com essa diferença.
group: Leia as duas colunas e peça que apontem a maior diferença.
Pergunta: The book written by my uncle won a prize.
extra90: Dupla: um fala como no Brasil, o outro como nos EUA.

pages.title: Mito ou fato? · 1/2

items.s: “The book written by him” means the book that was written by him.
We can say “the book wrote by him”.

pages.instruction: Decida e explique com suas palavras.

solo: Aluno responde e justifica; você mostra a pista.
group: Cada aluno decide sozinho, depois compare as respostas e peça uma justificativa.
Corrija pela pista do texto, não só dizendo “certo/errado”.
extra90: Peça que cada aluno invente uma pergunta igual para o colega.
answers: “The book written by him” means the book that was written by him. → Verdadeiro (Yes.)
We can say “the book wrote by him”. → Falso (Use the participle written.)
“The boxes delivered today” is correct. → Verdadeiro (Yes.)

pages.title: A signed book · 1/3
paragraphs: It is a windy afternoon in Chicago. A small bookshop stands on a quiet corner. Fay arranges the books in the window. A customer, Bia, comes in. She looks tired but excited. She has a special gift in mind.

“Welcome to the bookshop! Are you looking for anything special, or just enjoying the books displayed in the window?” says Fay. “Actually, yes. The book written by my uncle won a prize last year, and I wanted to buy a signed copy.” says Bia. “What a coincidence! We sell several novels from small publishers here in Chicago. What is the title?” says Fay.
